findings.summary: No single declaration packages Prop 7.6. Its clauses are spread across generic lemmas stated for R = Σ/ε (β = α−1), with Prop 7.5's outputs bundled as CovarianceControl. Linearity of Σ ↦ LΣ holds by definition, with no lemma stating it.

MemClass/MeanClass/WaveClass only assert smoothness on an open domain plus weighted jet bounds. The qualitative parts of W_α and M_α (∂_θ = 0, support in Ω_γ, common-torus descent, zero extension) are not in the class conclusions.

Smooth zero extension at the shell edges is proved only in a standalone local edge model with its own WeightedJets/PolyBound hypotheses. It is not derived from CovarianceControl or the MeanClass conclusions, and nothing else uses it.

The recovery argument's link to the actual pipeline is mis-cited. ActualSignedStageControls.nativeCovariance builds SignedCopyBounds.UniformNativeCovariance, not CovarianceControl. The actual (7.33) and W bounds come from parallel NativeCovariance lemmas.
